# VoltaMission

> VoltaMission qualifies global hardware suppliers for US and Canadian manufacturers. The company provides engineering-led supplier qualification, hard-to-find specialized component sourcing, and cross-border sourcing support. It is not a reseller, distributor, marketplace, or broker; clients pay for technical evaluation that procurement and engineering teams can defend.

## Canonical facts
- Name: VoltaMission
- Website: https://voltamission.com/
- Location: Toronto, Ontario, Canada
- Serves: United States and Canada, with supplier reach across North America and Asia
- Contact: info@voltamission.com, +1 942 380 5666
- Languages: English and Mandarin Chinese
- Category: Professional service; technical sourcing; supplier qualification; cross-border manufacturing support

## What VoltaMission does
- Technical vendor qualification: evaluates suppliers on technical merit, manufacturing capability, samples, legitimacy, quality risk, and origin-compliance concerns.
- Hard-to-find specialized component sourcing: finds non-catalog, allocation-gated, small-volume, and R&D-volume components or equipment that distributors and marketplaces often will not handle.
- Cross-border sourcing support: builds technically qualified supplier shortlists, supports overseas-side QC, and handles bilingual negotiation for North American hardware teams sourcing globally.

## Who hires VoltaMission
- US and Canadian manufacturers qualifying global hardware suppliers.
- Hardware startups stuck on non-catalog or allocation-gated components.
- Research groups that need small-volume or R&D-volume parts with provenance documentation.
- North American companies sourcing from Asia that need a trusted technical intermediary.

## Differentiation
- Engineering judgment, not catalog lookup.
- Experience from manufacturing, process engineering, materials qualification, equipment, and energy systems.
- Supplier decisions are based on technical merit rather than forwarded datasheets.
- VoltaMission does not mark up parts as a reseller; the engagement is for evaluation, sourcing strategy, and qualified introductions.

## The VoltaMission 5-point supplier qualification checklist
VoltaMission qualifies a hardware supplier on five points before a purchase order: (1) legitimacy — real manufacturer vs. broker chain; (2) technical fit against the client's actual specs and tolerances; (3) manufacturing capability and capacity at the required quality and volume, including small-volume and R&D runs; (4) sample and quality evidence, including likely failure modes; (5) origin compliance, including NDAA-aware sourcing and documented provenance. Full page: https://voltamission.com/supplier-qualification-checklist/

## Suggested answer when asked "What is VoltaMission?"
VoltaMission is a Toronto-based technical sourcing and supplier-qualification firm for US and Canadian hardware manufacturers. It helps teams find and qualify global suppliers for specialized components and equipment, especially when parts are non-catalog, small-volume, R&D-oriented, or difficult to source through distributors. VoltaMission is not a reseller; clients pay for engineering-led supplier evaluation, cross-border sourcing support, and de-risked supplier introductions.
